title: Fix chronological sequence ordering and validation

root_cause.mechanism: autoSequence appended anchor-based overflow rows AFTER server-validated rows without a final sort or revalidation
root_cause.reported_shape: on a late-anchored overbooked day, overflow is laid out from 17:15 while the plan already reaches 23:15; merged sequence was descending and the server rejected it: sequence not in chronological start order at 'Log hours' ('17:15' < preceding '23:15')

production: frontend/src/store/controller.ts: added byStartThenId comparator (start HH:MM lexicographic, id tiebreak mirroring app/sequence.py merge_immutable_rows sort key)
frontend/src/store/controller.ts: final merged sequence is [...rows, ...overflow].sort(byStartThenId) before SEQUENCE_OK dispatch; sort reorders, never drops
fix.no_backend_production_change: app/sequence.py merge_immutable_rows already sorts by (start, id) and validate_sequence already hard-rejects descending order; behavior pinned by new tests instead

regression_tests.test: FEEDBACK-01 chronological sequence ordering > sorts overflow after server rows — Log hours at 17:15 precedes the 23:15 row
regression_tests.behavior: fixture-only: mocked loadPlanInputs (anchor 17:15, Log hours assigned) and mocked autoSequence (rows reaching 23:15, Log hours dropped); asserts merged sequence is chronologically ordered, Log hours at 17:15 precedes the 23:15 row, no rows dropped, overflowIds includes Log hours
regression_tests.red_before_fix: failed at the descending 17:15 < 23:15 pair; green after fix

regression_tests.behavior: pins validate_sequence hard rejection of the exact reported shape with the deterministic chronological error
pins merge_immutable_rows output is chronological after a model 23:15 copy is replaced by an immutable 17:15 pin

safety_proof.live_post_sequence_adjust_commit: none — adapter.autoSequence mocked in the regression; backend tests are pure unit tests
safety_proof.branch_or_index_mutation: none — no commit, stage, reset, clean, stash, rebase, or merge
safety_proof.foreign_changes_preserved: tracked dirty work (.gitignore, AGENTS.md, README.md, gem-team.yaml, .opencode, extraction plan.yaml) untouched; edited files live in untracked frontend/ and app/ dirs
